title: Reverse a singly linked list
prompt: In list.js, implement the exported function reverse(head) that reverses a singly linked list and returns the new head. Each node is a plain object shaped { value, next }, where next is null for the last node. Do not mutate node identities in a way that loses values -- reuse the existing nodes, just relink them. The helper functions fromArray/toArray in list.js already work and are used by test.js -- do not change them or test.js.
